leadText:
Not to be confused with Model (Trainer class) or Beautiful (condition).
 
A Beauty (Japanese: のおねえさん Grown-Up Woman; in Generation I, also known as おねえさん Woman) is a type of Pokémon Trainer that debuted in the Generation I , also appearing on water routes due to the lack of female s. They are older versions of es 
In the Battle Maison from Pokémon X and Y, Beauty Nova is implied to be . She says that she was reborn as a Beauty after originally being a (a male-only ); in the Japanese versions, she credits this transformation to medical science. In the German and Korean versions, this implication is removed, with her instead having been a female or a Girl (Korean: 태권도 소녀 Taekwondo Sonyeo), a gender-swapped version of the Korean name for the Black Belt Trainer class, respectively.
Before battle: "I've recently remade my life completely! I've been reborn as a Beauty at last!"
After winning: "If you want to make your dreams reality, then you have to be completely dedicated!"
After losing: "Yes, a mere half year ago I was a Black Belt! Quite the transformation, wouldn't you say?"
In the Battle Maison from Pokémon Omega Ruby and Alpha Sapphire, Beauty Bunnie pretends to be an adult woman, but she is 7 years old in the English, Japanese, and Korean versions, 13 years old in the German and Italian versions, or 15 years old in the Spanish version. Conversely, she is 45 years old in the French version, where she is pretending to be younger instead.
Before battle: "Hey there, Trainer! Do you think I’m a grown-up?"
After winning: "Tee hee... I won because I’m a grown-up!"
After losing: "Tee hee! My mom did my makeup! I’m actually only seven years old!"
